profiles.description: Leafy salad vegetables: lettuce spinach and tender green leaves grown for harvesting fresh foliage.
Mature fruiting vegetable crops: tomato pepper and eggplant with developing fruit.
Mediterranean woody culinary herbs: rosemary thyme sage and drought tolerant aromatic shrubs.
